name: data: RadGenome-ChestCT ingest+preprocess (paper smoke)
command: python -m voxtoken.data.ingest --config voxtoken/configs/data_ingest_radgenome_chestct_paper_smoke_e0940.yaml && python -m voxtoken.data.preprocess --config voxtoken/configs/data_preprocess_radgenome_chestct_paper_smoke_e0940.yaml && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_manifest --in artifacts/radgenome_proc_e0940_smoke/manifest.jsonl --require-n-ge 50 --valid-splits train val test --require-report-path-exists --require-volume-path-exists --require-nonempty-volume-paths-ge 50 --require-case-id-prefix train_

name: data: build GT manifest from RadGenome anatomy masks (lung nodule) (paper smoke)
command: python -m voxtoken.data.radgenome_mask_manifest --in artifacts/radgenome_proc_e0940_smoke/manifest.jsonl --out artifacts/radgenome_gt_lung_nodule_e0941 --config voxtoken/configs/ct_rate_ts_grounding_e0907.yaml --radgenome-root /data/tiasha/RadGenome-ChestCT --mask "lung nodule" --max-cases-train 80 --max-cases-val 20 --max-cases-test 0 && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_ct_rate_ts_manifest --in artifacts/radgenome_gt_lung_nodule_e0941/manifest.jsonl --require-n-ge 20 --require-gt-is-pseudo --require-coord-system token_space_mm && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_split_counts --in artifacts/radgenome_gt_lung_nodule_e0941/manifest.jsonl --require-train-ge 10 --require-val-ge 5

name: policy: build dataset + train torch policy (seed0) (paper smoke)
eval: benchmark (fixed/heuristic/learned/random/oracle) (seed0) (paper smoke)
command: python -m voxtoken.runner.ct_rate_grounding_benchmark --manifest artifacts/radgenome_gt_lung_nodule_e0941/manifest.jsonl --out artifacts/e0943_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_seed0 --config voxtoken/configs/ct_rate_ts_grounding_e0907.yaml --budgets 8 --max-cases 20 --split val --seed 0 --policy-ckpt outputs/train_policy/E0942_seed0/checkpoint.json && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_grounding_benchmark --in artifacts/e0943_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_seed0/summary.json --require-methods fixed heuristic learned random oracle
